newsitem.title: USA: Parkway Properties makes stock offering.
newsitem.headline: Parkway Properties makes stock offering.

text.p: Parkway Properties Inc said Wednesday it will offer 1,750,000 common shares at $27 each under its existing shelf registration statement.
The company said it will use the $44.7 million in net proceeds for general corporate purposes, like buying office properties and paying off $7.4 million in debt.
For the third quarter ended September 1996, Parkway Properties had 4.2 million weighted average shares outstanding.
